title: No disjunction, no F04 and F07
text: Every theory with P-AND-WK and no weak or other disjunction principle has no disjunction: it cannot express F04 and F07 (both use 'or'), so those cells are out of scope. This is expressibility, not failure.
evidence: T-WK: F04 and F07 are out_of_scope in data/results.json.
note: Adding P-OR-WK would make them testable.

title: Order asymmetry separates Middle Kleene from Strong Kleene
text: With felicity as definedness everywhere, T-MK and T-WK derive the infelicity of 'a and s' (F02) while T-SK does not: Strong Kleene makes 'a and s' defined, hence felicitous.
evidence: F02: T-MK pass, T-WK pass, T-SK fail.

title: Only Middle Kleene gets both orders right
text: Weak Kleene fails F01 (it makes 's and a' undefined when there is no king) and Strong Kleene fails F02; Middle Kleene passes both. This is the order asymmetry result in the toy fragment.
evidence: F01: T-WK fail. F02: T-SK fail. T-MK passes both.

title: Felicity somewhere is too permissive
text: Replacing P-FELIC-DEF by P-FELIC-SOME in T-MK breaks F02 and F03: any discourse defined in some model counts as felicitous, including the bare trigger. The fix loses two facts for no gain.
note: A creative variant that did not pay off; kept as a worked example of a fix.

title: Excluded middle fails in every trivalent theory that can state it
text: F07 (a or not a is not valid) holds in T-SK and T-MK because a is undefined when there is no king.
note: Depends on the auxiliary constraint P-AUX-PRESUP: without it a is a free three-valued atom, but the result also holds.
